name: LankaQR CLI
description: Inspect QR payloads, parse TLV fields, and verify CRC checksums offline. An experimental developer toolkit, not a certified payment implementation.
installation:
# Requires Node.js 22.18+
git clone https://github.com/AppKade/lanka-qr-cli.git
cd lanka-qr-cli
npm install
npm test
npm run build
npm run dev -- parse "00020153031445802LK"

name: Legacy Bridge
description: Inspect SOAP/WSDL operations and run preliminary XML and local import checks. MCP and REST adapter generation is planned.
installation:
# Requires Node.js 20+
git clone https://github.com/AppKade/legacy-bridge.git
cd legacy-bridge
npm install
npm run dev -- inspect examples/inventory.wsdl
npm run dev -- validate examples/inventory.wsdl --json

name: AppKade Open Website
description: The open-source website for discovering AppKade projects, contributing to them, and recognizing verified GitHub contributions.
installation:
git clone https://github.com/AppKade/open.git
cd open
corepack enable
pnpm install
pnpm dev

name: Singularity
description: An animated WebGL black hole for your website. Tune it in the playground, then copy the code or a ready-made prompt for your AI coding agent.
installation:
git clone https://github.com/AppKade/singularity.git
cd singularity
npm test
npm start   # then open http://localhost:8080

name: LK Tax MCP
description: Local Sri Lankan individual income tax estimates through MCP, with deterministic calculations and cited results. Development preview, not ready for filing.
installation:
# Requires Node.js 22.18+
git clone https://github.com/AppKade/lk-tax-mcp.git
cd lk-tax-mcp
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm start
